proposals.before: Liao Director of Astronomy Dao Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what no human hand can make."
proposals.after: Liao Director of Astronomy Kong Zhihe arrived and said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what no human hand can make."
proposals.reason: Chinese 遼司天到孔致和 uses 到 as the verb arrived; the personal name is 孔致和, not a surname Dao.

proposals.before: Liao Director of Astronomy Dao Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what human effort cannot bring about."
proposals.after: Liao Director of Astronomy Kong Zhihe arrived and said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what human effort cannot bring about."
proposals.reason: Chinese 到 is the verb of arrival before the astronomer name 孔致和, not part of a three-character personal name.

proposals.before: Before the year was out, Hailing issued an edict for the southern campaign.
proposals.after: At year's end, Hailing issued an edict for the southern campaign.
proposals.reason: Chinese 未歲 is the common graphic variant of 末歲 (year's end); 'before the year was out' is acceptable but 'at year's end' matches the annalistic formula more closely.

proposals.before: Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shendian Hall burned and the fire spread to Taihe and Houde halls.
proposals.after: Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shenlong Hall burned and the fire spread to Taihe and Houde halls.
proposals.reason: 神龍殿 is Shenlong Hall; Shendian is a mistranslation of 神龍.

proposals.before: Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shendian Hall burned, spreading to Taihe and Houde halls.
proposals.after: Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shenlong Hall burned, spreading to Taihe and Houde halls.
proposals.reason: 神龍殿 is Shenlong Hall; Shendian is a mistranslation of 神龍.

proposals.before: Eighth month, fifth month, on jiazi: at Bei Wangdian marsh a great wind; hail fell over ten li wide and sixty li long.
proposals.after: Eighth year, fifth month, on jiazi: at Bei Wangdian marsh a great wind; hail fell over ten li wide and sixty li long.
proposals.reason: 八月五月 is the same dating the idiomatic already treats as 八年五月 (eighth year, fifth month), not two months stacked.

proposals.before: In the twelfth month Mizhou presented one white crane and one white pheasant.
proposals.after: In the twelfth month Mizhou presented one white quail and one white pheasant.
proposals.reason: 白鶉 is a white quail; 鶉 is not 鶴 (crane).

proposals.before: Twelfth month: Mizhou presented one white crane and one white pheasant.
proposals.after: Twelfth month: Mizhou presented one white quail and one white pheasant.
proposals.reason: 白鶉 is a white quail; 鶉 is not 鶴 (crane).

proposals.before: In the second year of Taihe, eighth month, on bingshen, at the Stone Drum Mountain Sage Terrace in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers shone in five colors, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long like a carp’s tail and taller than a man; nine smaller young stood beside them, each four or five chi high.
proposals.after: In the second year of Taihe, eighth month, on bingshen, at the Stone Sage Terrace of Drum Mountain in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers shone in five colors, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long like a carp’s tail and taller than a man; nine smaller young stood beside them, each four or five chi high.
proposals.reason: Chinese 鼓山石聖台 names Drum Mountain (鼓山) and the Stone Sage Terrace (石聖台); the idiomatic English fuses 鼓 with 石 as ‘Stone Drum Mountain’.

proposals.before: Taihe second year, eighth month, bingshen: at the Stone Drum Mountain Sage Terrace in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers were brilliantly five-colored, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long, shaped like a carp’s tail and tall enough to surpass a man; nine young somewhat smaller attended at the side, likewise four or five chi in height.
proposals.after: Taihe second year, eighth month, bingshen: at the Stone Sage Terrace of Drum Mountain in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers were brilliantly five-colored, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long, shaped like a carp’s tail and tall enough to surpass a man; nine young somewhat smaller attended at the side, likewise four or five chi in height.
proposals.reason: Chinese 鼓山石聖台 is Drum Mountain’s Stone Sage Terrace, not ‘Stone Drum Mountain Sage Terrace’.

proposals.before: In Shao Wang's first Da'an year the Yellow River ran clear along the Xu–Pi border for more than five hundred li for nearly two years, and an edict proclaimed it throughout court and realm.
proposals.after: In King Shao of Wei's first Da'an year the Yellow River ran clear along the Xu–Pi border for more than five hundred li for nearly two years, and an edict proclaimed it throughout court and realm.
proposals.reason: Chinese 衛紹王 names King Shao of Wei; the idiomatic English drops 衛 and leaves only Shao Wang.

proposals.before: Shao Wang, Da'an year 1: along the Xu and Pi border the Yellow River ran clear for more than five hundred li, nearly two years; an edict on the matter was sent to court and realm.
proposals.after: King Shao of Wei, Da'an year 1: along the Xu and Pi border the Yellow River ran clear for more than five hundred li, nearly two years; an edict on the matter was sent to court and realm.
proposals.reason: The literal likewise omits 衛 from 衛紹王.

proposals.before: Chongqing 1, seventh month, at the wei hour before noon: wind from the east lifted a bolt of silk dozens of zhang high, coiled it like a dragon, and dropped it inside Gongchen Gate.
proposals.after: Chongqing 1, seventh month, at the wei hour in the afternoon: wind from the east lifted a bolt of silk dozens of zhang high, coiled it like a dragon, and dropped it inside Gongchen Gate.
proposals.reason: 未時 is the early-afternoon double-hour, not a time before noon.

proposals.before: Chongqing year 1, seventh month, at the wei hour before noon: wind came from the east and blew a length of silk dozens of zhang high; it twisted like a dragon and fell inside Gongchen Gate.
proposals.after: Chongqing year 1, seventh month, at the wei hour in the afternoon: wind came from the east and blew a length of silk dozens of zhang high; it twisted like a dragon and fell inside Gongchen Gate.
proposals.reason: 未時 is after midday; before noon contradicts the Chinese hour.

proposals.before: Tenth month, on bingchen: northwestern mist piled like earthen ramparts and did not lift until the second watch.
proposals.after: Tenth month, on bingshen: northwestern mist piled like earthen ramparts and did not lift until the second watch.
proposals.reason: 丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen.

proposals.before: Tenth month, on bingchen, in the northwest mist like piled earth; it scattered only at the second watch.
proposals.after: Tenth month, on bingshen, in the northwest mist like piled earth; it scattered only at the second watch.
proposals.reason: 丙申 is bingshen; bingchen would be 丙辰.

proposals.before: Second year, first month, at wuwu noon a thousand cranes wheeled above the palace court and did not leave for a full quarter-hour.
proposals.after: Second year, first month, at xinyou noon a thousand cranes wheeled above the palace court and did not leave for a full quarter-hour.
proposals.reason: Chinese 辛酉 is the day xinyou, not wuwu (戊午).

proposals.before: Second year, first month, at wuwu noon, more than a thousand cranes soared over the palace courtyard and departed only after a quarter-hour.
proposals.after: Second year, first month, at xinyou noon, more than a thousand cranes soared over the palace courtyard and departed only after a quarter-hour.
proposals.reason: Chinese 辛酉 is the day xinyou, not wuwu (戊午).

proposals.before: Aizong, Zhengda 1, first month, on wuwu: the emperor held his first audience, raising the empress dowager to Rensheng Palace and the Grand Consort to Cisheng Palace.
proposals.after: Aizong, Zhengda 1, first month, on wuwu: the emperor held his first audience, honoring the empress dowager as Empress Dowager of Rensheng Palace and the Grand Consort as Empress Dowager of Cisheng Palace.
proposals.reason: The Chinese 尊太后為仁聖宮皇太后，太元妃為慈聖宮皇太后 records honorific titles, not a move into palaces; the idiomatic rendering drops 皇太后 and treats the palace names as destinations.

decisions.after: Liao Director of Astronomy Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what no human hand can make."
decisions.reason: Dao is a false surname from 到, and the name is 孔致和; but 到 does not stand as a verb of arrival before the name (that would be 孔致和到). The Taizu annal parallel is 司天孔致和 with no arrival. Drop Dao and do not insert arrived.

decisions.after: Liao Director of Astronomy Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what human effort cannot bring about."
decisions.reason: The same 到 is not part of the personal name and is not a motion verb placed before 孔致和. Restore Kong Zhihe said, without arrived.

The received text is 未歲, not 末歲; 'before the year was out' already matches 未歲 and the eighth-month omens that precede Hailing’s southern campaign. Recasting it as year’s end is an unforced emendation and a stylistic swap the proposer itself calls acceptable either way.
神龍殿 is Shenlong Hall (divine-dragon hall). Shendian would require 神殿 and is a mistranslation of 龍.
The literal likewise misreads 神龍殿 as Shendian; Shenlong Hall is the accurate name.
八月五月 as two months is impossible after 七年九月 and before a following 六月 then 十年正月. The date is the eighth year, fifth month (八年五月), which the idiomatic already uses.
白鶉 is a white quail; 鶴 would be required for crane. The replacement is accurate.
The literal repeats the crane error; 白鶉 is quail, paired with 白雉 pheasant.
鼓山石聖台 is Drum Mountain plus Stone Sage Terrace; Stone Drum Mountain wrongly binds 石 to 鼓.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 磁州武安縣鼓山石聖台

decisions.reason: The literal makes the same place-name error; Stone Sage Terrace of Drum Mountain matches 鼓山石聖台.
The Chinese title is 衛紹王, King Shao of Wei; Shao Wang omits 衛.
The literal likewise drops 衛 from 衛紹王; King Shao of Wei is the full title.

decisions.after: Chongqing 1, seventh month, on xinwei at the wei hour in the afternoon: wind from the east lifted a bolt of silk dozens of zhang high, coiled it like a dragon, and dropped it inside Gongchen Gate.
decisions.reason: 未時 is the early-afternoon double-hour, so before noon is wrong; the proposal still omits the day 辛未 that precedes 未時.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 崇慶元年七月辛未未時

decisions.after: Chongqing year 1, seventh month, on xinwei at the wei hour in the afternoon: wind came from the east and blew a length of silk dozens of zhang high; it twisted like a dragon and fell inside Gongchen Gate.
decisions.reason: Correct the hour to afternoon, and restore the sexagenary day 辛未 still missing from the proposed literal.
丙申 is bingshen; bingchen would be 丙辰.
The literal repeats bingchen for 丙申; bingshen is required.
辛酉日午 is the day xinyou at noon; wuwu would be 戊午.
The literal has the same day error; 辛酉 is xinyou, not wuwu.
尊太后為仁聖宮皇太后，太元妃為慈聖宮皇太后 confers palace-named empress-dowager titles; it does not move the women into those palaces.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 尊太后為仁聖宮皇太后，太元妃為慈聖宮皇太后

claimRetractions.reason: s0196 writes 衛紹王, not a separate title 紹王; the Shao Wang name claim was produced only by dropping 衛 in the English.

claimRevisions.reason: The English personal name Dao Kong Zhihe was created by taking 到 as a surname; the name in the Chinese is 孔致和.
